feedback.answered: The follower half of the discriminator is settled by executed evidence. Exploration check 6c1f4fbd37ad49e79cd922b03259d1fe built a two-node in-process cluster with both addresses as voters and their InmemTransports connected, then failed every StoreLogs call on the detected follower while the leader ran a real AddVoter. Event follower_store_failure reports store_log_attempts 8 and store_log_failures 8, follower_published_phantom false, follower_servers_after equal to follower_servers_before, follower_durable_before and follower_durable_after both 2, and follower_last_index 2. So a follower-side durable failure does not publish the configuration or advance the follower's cached last-log index: appendEntries stores new entries and only reaches processConfigurationLogEntry after a successful StoreLogs, so the failure returns first. This is a bounded negative result and it is specific to the whole-call failure timing that was exercised.
remaining: Whether a StoreLogs failure that happens after appendEntries has already deleted a conflicting log suffix leaves the follower's cached last-log index above its durable content, and what that in turn makes the follower report to a leader
feedback.rationale: The recorded unknown asked which StoreLogs failure timings leave the published configuration and the cached last-log state inconsistent, and whether a follower-side store failure reaches the same divergence. Exploration 6c1f4fbd37ad49e79cd922b03259d1fe answers the follower question for the whole-call timing (no publication, no cached-index advance) while the confirmed direct check already fixes the leader-side result for that timing. What remains is a distinct discriminator: the truncation path in appendEntries deletes a conflicting suffix and then stores the replacement entries in the same call, so a StoreLogs failure there returns before setLastLog; the in-code TODO in the captured source states exactly that the cached last log is left in the wrong state if there was a truncation above. That timing is not exercised by any retained execution, so it stays an open sourced hypothesis rather than being folded into the confirmed finding.
